title: Scenario 1: Leopard Early Warning (Raiwala)
subtitle: Crepuscular carnivore approach toward domestic cattle sheds
description: Simulates an automated sequence of camera trap triggers (CAM-017, CAM-018) along a seasonal drainage ravine leading straight into Raiwala Ward 4. Watch the 3D map trace the historical approach, project the forward AI ingress trajectory, highlight the conflict risk zone, and enable Rapid Response Team Alpha dispatch.

aiThoughtProcess.model: ARANYA Decision Support Engine v2.4 (Friction Surface + Least-Cost Corridors)
aiThoughtProcess.predictionSummary: High-confidence predatory approach toward domestic cattle corrals in Raiwala Ward 4

reasoningSteps.detail: Animal is descending a seasonal scrub gully (slope 9°), which provides a natural path of least physical resistance avoiding 38° ridgelines.
Riverine scrub canopy density exceeds 78%, masking nocturnal movement from village perimeter searchlights.
14 unfortified domestic cattle corrals are situated at the ravine mouth; previous leopard cattle predation recorded 9 days ago.
Predicted path deflects away from the bright illumination of the Haridwar-Rishikesh highway corridor.

recommendedActions: Deploy Quick Response Team (QRT) Unit Alpha to Sector 4 intercept culvert
Trigger perimeter solar acoustic sirens along ravine mouth
Broadcast instant automated SMS alert to Raiwala Ward 4 residents

steps.message: CAM-017 triggered: Adult male leopard detected moving downhill in scrub gully.
CAM-018 triggered: Sighting 140m closer to village perimeter fence.
Risk Engine updated: Raiwala Sector 4 escalated to CRITICAL (87/100).
Priority Alert Generated: Solitary Leopard Approaching Cattle Pens.

title: Scenario 2: Corridor Pinch-Point (Chilla-Motichur)
subtitle: Breeding herd attempting high-risk railway crossing
description: Examines corridor fragmentation where an elephant breeding herd of 6 individuals approaches the Haridwar-Dehradun railway embankment. AI projects track crossing at KM-42, prompting train deceleration protocols and solar deterrent activation.

aiThoughtProcess.model: ARANYA Pachyderm Corridor Model (Markov Chain + Track Bathymetry)
aiThoughtProcess.predictionSummary: Elephant herd moving across railway embankment to access western Motichur foraging grounds

reasoningSteps.detail: Herd follows historic autumn corridor connecting Chilla water supply to western Rajaji sal forests.
Sugarcane plots on the west embankment have high sugar content detected by satellite NDVI (0.74).
A 120m corridor bottleneck between flyover pillars forces the herd directly over open rail tracks.
Scheduled Dehradun Shatabdi Express is due through the section at 19:10 IST, creating high risk of collision.

recommendedActions: Issue emergency 20 km/h train speed restriction to Northern Railway DRM Moradabad
Deploy Track Watchers with high-intensity beam searchlights to KM-42 culvert
Activate acoustic bee sound deterrent along rail embankment

steps.message: CAM-022 triggered: Herd of 6 elephants including juvenile detected near railway culvert.
Corridor bottleneck collision risk elevated to HIGH (84/100).
Railway Warning Broadcast: Northern Railway Control requested to restrict section speed to 20 km/h.

title: Scenario 3: Habitat Pressure & Resort Fringe (Ramnagar)
subtitle: Apex predator navigation through encroached riparian buffer
description: Visualizes the impact of tourist resort development along the Kosi riverbed. AI projects a male tiger moving through a narrow riparian gravel bed between hotels, triggering evening pedestrian curfew advisories.

aiThoughtProcess.predictionSummary: Adult male tiger navigating dry Kosi riverbed between tourist properties

reasoningSteps.detail: Tiger uses gravel riverbed to avoid resort fencing while moving between Corbett core and southern buffer.
Evening riverside dining decks at Dhikuli resorts place unaware tourists within 60m of animal's path.

recommendedActions: Issue mandatory outdoor curfew advisory to all Dhikuli riverside resorts
Deploy Corbett Buffer Quick Response Vehicle to river access road

steps.message: CAM-025 triggered: Adult male tiger sighted crossing dry river channel towards resort boundary.
Ramnagar River Corridor risk elevated to HIGH (74/100) due to tourist proximity.
Resort Security Advisory: Immediate perimeter pedestrian curfew issued.

title: Scenario 4: Perimeter Disturbance & Snare Threat
subtitle: Nocturnal human incursion in Shyampur Reserved Forest
description: Simulates off-trail nocturnal activity along the reserved forest ditch where wire snares are historically placed. Dispatches anti-poaching patrol unit for ground comb.

aiThoughtProcess.predictionSummary: Unauthorized human presence detected near wildlife movement trail along boundary trench

reasoningSteps.detail: Night-time movement (02:15 IST) along boundary ditch violates forest curfew rules.
Compartment 4 ditch previously had 6 wire snares recovered during 2025 anti-poaching sweeps.

recommendedActions: Dispatch Shyampur Anti-Poaching Patrol with metal detectors for ground sweep
Notify Haridwar Forest Division Flying Squad

steps.message: CAM-009 triggered: Thermal sensor flags unauthorized flashlight presence inside forest boundary.
Shyampur buffer vulnerability raised to HIGH (82/100).
Anti-Poaching Dispatch: Foot patrol team assigned for immediate snare sweep.
